name: Raon-1 mini (preview)

lineage.how_derived: trained from scratch; preview release, a final model is announced; MXFP8, NVFP4, MLX and DFlash2 draft repos exist

purpose: Korean-strong 30B-A4B MoE with built-in thinking, tool calling and agent execution (Hermes Agent, Pi, OpenCode); Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French and Thai (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: hybrid linear-attention MoE (Raon Delta Attention 3 : Gated MLA 1, NoPE)
architecture.attention: 18 Raon Delta Attention layers (fixed state) and 7 Gated MLA layers (KV cache about 8 KiB per token in BF16); 40 heads
architecture.recurrent: Raon Delta Attention (decoupled erase and write gates of Kimi Delta Attention)
architecture.why_this_design: Only the 7 MLA layers keep a KV cache and the other 18 have a fixed-size state, so long context is cheap; Raon-mHC lowers the cost of manifold-constrained hyper-connections (card).

variants.notes: IQ4_XS 16.07, Q6_K 25.84, Q8_0 30.69 GB; DFlash draft Q8_0 0.73 GB; 49k downloads

pc-12gb.notes: 19.69 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4.3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 19.69 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4.3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 19.69 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 19.69 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 19.69 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 19.69 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 19.69 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF published; custom attention types, support level not verified.

weaknesses: preview; benchmark charts are images only (no numbers extracted)
soft.maturity: 5k downloads of the gated main repo, 49k of the GGUF

tona_fit.reason: The relevant model for Korean users at 12 to 24 GB: 4.3B active, small KV cache, official GGUF, Apache-2.0 (text read). No numbers readable yet; revisit at the final release.
